snippet.title: Persona 4 Revival — Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The chances of your screen turning into a portal to another world are low, but never zero… 📺

Persona 4 Revival is officially announced for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, Xbox Cloud, PlayStation 5, and Steam!

Wishlist now on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC, and Xbox Cloud: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/persona-4-revival/9n40dk5n4ld4
